# Dr Smrithi Homeopathy Clinic

> Homeopathy clinic in Mandavelipakkam, Chennai, run by Dr. Smrithi Chellama, BHMS (Sai Ram Homeopathy Medical College and Research Centre, The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University), with more than 5 years of practice. In-clinic visits by appointment, online consultations, and medicines delivered home.

- Address: No. 107, 2nd Trust Main Road, Mandavelipakkam, Chennai 600028, Tamil Nadu, India. Close to Mylapore, Raja Annamalai Puram, Adyar, Alwarpet and Santhome.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 73388 22967
- Email: drsmrithi17@gmail.com
- Timings: Monday to Saturday 10 AM to 2 PM and 4 PM to 8 PM. Sunday 10 AM to 2 PM. In-clinic visits by appointment only.

- [Homeopathy treatments](https://drsmrithi.online/treatments/): skin, breathing and allergies, digestion, stress and sleep, joints and muscles, and women's health, with what to expect at a visit and when to see a doctor urgently
- [Contact and booking](https://drsmrithi.online/contact/): booking form, timings, map and directions

## Notes

- Treatment is chosen for each person after a detailed consultation. Results differ from person to person and no result is guaranteed.
- Patients are asked not to stop medicines prescribed by their other doctors.
- Not for emergencies. In an emergency call 108 or go to the nearest hospital.
